title: The rise of the agentic economy on the shoulders of MCP — Jan Curn, Apify
talk_summary: Apify argues MCP's key advantage is dynamic tool discovery: agents search a registry and load only the tools needed for the current workflow, avoiding huge OpenAPI-style contexts. They demo a marketplace where one account/token exposes thousands of actors and nested MCP servers, with central credentials and monetization.

takeaways.technique: Lazy tool discovery via search/load meta-tools
takeaways.what_they_do: They expose a small search/add-actor meta-tool; the agent searches Apify's tool registry and adds only the chosen tool to context.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the client connects to the MCP server and dynamically discovers tools to use and to interact with

takeaways.technique: Nested MCP parent server as aggregator
takeaways.what_they_do: A parent MCP server can expose tools from nested MCP servers, so one connection surfaces many backends.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the MCP servers they can be actually nested you can have like one parent server that provides actions or tools of the like nested MCP servers

takeaways.technique: Central credential broker / one-token MCP gateway
takeaways.what_they_do: The marketplace holds third-party credentials and exposes services through one account/token, so agents do not manage per-service tokens.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you just need one API token or one authentication one account to to get access to all the other services

takeaways.technique: Eval tool discovery before trusting it
takeaways.what_they_do: The speaker admits autonomous discovery is still flaky and that making agentic systems behave as expected is tricky.
takeaways.evidence_quote: making sure that the system works as expected is tricky right even if it's fixed

takeaways.what_they_do: They create an account, store the API token, and publish an external MCP server as a connector without the provider's cooperation.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we created an account browser base, added our API token there and published like basically their MCP server on our store
